summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the grant of a new European patent for mobile device classification using sensor fusion. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a non-material operational event—patent grants are ordinary-course IP developments. No deal terms, structural changes, or strategic alternatives are discussed. This is a standard current report; no special-situation classification applies. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other listed category.
